title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Forwarding Gateway Helpers Architecture
purpose: Define public helper methods on DoqMessage for zeroing and generating DNS Message IDs when forwarding DNS messages between DoQ and other transports.
design_summary: Two static helper methods on DoqMessage: NormalizeToDoq zeroes the two-octet DNS Message ID when forwarding a message into DoQ; GenerateMessageId writes a caller-supplied 16-bit identifier into the Message ID field when forwarding a message out of DoQ. Both methods copy the input span to a new byte array and validate minimum length.
data_and_state_considerations: No new adapter state is required. Both methods are pure functions with no side effects.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Both methods reject payloads shorter than 2 bytes.
NormalizeToDoq always writes 0x0000 as the Message ID.
GenerateMessageId accepts any ushort (0-65535) including 0, though 0 is not meaningful for outbound forwarding.
The caller is responsible for choosing unique message IDs when forwarding.
risks: These are utility methods only; they do not enforce gateway-level semantics.

supplemental_sections.heading: Implementation Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: These helpers are pure static methods on the DoqMessage struct. No changes to the codec, stream, or client/server adapters are required.
